# Security policy

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub's vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/slack-go/slack/security/advisories/new).

Include the affected library and Go versions, the potential impact, and a minimal reproduction or steps to reproduce. Remove real tokens, signing secrets, and other credentials from examples.

Keep vulnerability details out of public issues while the report is being investigated. Use [GitHub issues](https://github.com/slack-go/slack/issues) for ordinary bugs and feature requests.
